title: Colonel Coleman's B-25 UFO encounter over Alabama

tellings.quote: that led me to to Colonel William Coleman who had that dramatic encounter uh with UFO and B-55 over Alabama,

plain: A documentary filmmaker named James Fox says his research led him to an Air Force officer, Colonel William Coleman. According to Fox, Coleman had a dramatic encounter with a UFO in the 1950s while flying a B-25, a military bomber plane, over Alabama. If true, it would be a close sighting by an experienced military pilot.
